requirements: R1: Ensure the backend Spring Boot application binds to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) instead of the loopback interface (127.0.0.1) so that Docker container health checks can connect.

slices.title: Configure Backend Network Binding in application.properties
slices.jtbd: When implementing the network binding fix for this epic, I want to explicitly set server.address to 0.0.0.0, so that the health check can successfully connect and prove the product runs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend service runs in a Docker container
When the application starts
Then Tomcat binds to 0.0.0.0
And the orchestrator health check successfully connects.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container health check connection aborts to 0%
